strings.audit_alert_threshold_zero_nan: A threshold is not a valid number (NaN/Infinity); it is treated as 0, so that rule is off. Set a valid value.
strings.audit_alert_threshold_zero_zero: A threshold is 0, so that rule is off. Keep 0 to disable it, or set a positive value to alert.
strings.audit_alerts_no_targets: Resource and offline alerts are on, but neither has a usable push target (no resource/offline rule and no default target). Alerts will not reach any chat. Set a group number under Alerts & daily card → default push target.
strings.audit_alerts_offline_no_targets: Offline / recovery notices have no usable push target (no offline rule and no default target); a disconnect will not be reported.
strings.audit_alerts_resource_no_targets: Resource alerts (CPU / RAM / SWAP / disk / load) have no usable push target (no resource rule and no default target); they will not be delivered.
strings.audit_daily_report_no_targets: The daily report is on but has no usable push target (no daily rule and no default target); it will not be sent.
strings.audit_daily_report_sections_empty: No report section is selected, so the scheduled daily report will not be sent. Select at least one module, or turn the daily report off.
strings.audit_daily_report_sections_unknown: The report sections contain unknown modules: {unknown}. Allowed: {allowed}. They are ignored; if no valid section remains, no report is sent.
strings.audit_daily_summary_no_targets: The daily status card is on but has no usable push target (no daily_image rule and no default target); it will be skipped silently and not retried that day.
strings.audit_disk_path_missing: Disk mount "{path}" does not exist: the status card, reports and dashboard will show --. Check Status card display → disk mounts.
strings.audit_display_timezone_invalid: Unknown timezone "{tz_name}"; the plugin falls back to the server local timezone, shifting the status card, alerts and reports. Check the spelling (e.g. Asia/Shanghai).
strings.audit_failed_message: The config audit did not finish (failed or timed out). Check the log or run the "状态卡诊断" command.
strings.audit_history_exceeds_retention: The trend window ({history_days} days) is longer than resource retention ({retention_days} days); the chart will miss {missing} day(s). Increase retention or shorten the trend window.
strings.audit_invalid_schedule_time: A scheduled send time is invalid ("{raw}"); it must be HH:MM, and the task will not run.
strings.audit_legacy_module_targets: A module has its own target list, which overrides the default push target. Clear it under that group's "show advanced options" if you meant one destination for everything.
strings.audit_monitor_item_skipped_duplicate: Monitor item "{name}" duplicates an earlier entry and was ignored.
strings.audit_monitor_item_skipped_unsupported_t: Monitor item "{name}" has an unsupported type ("{kind}") and was skipped.
strings.audit_monitors_all_invalid: Service monitoring is on, but every item has an unsupported type or incomplete configuration; nothing will be probed or alerted. Check each item's type and required fields.
strings.audit_monitors_no_items: Service monitoring is on, but the item list is empty (or every item is disabled); nothing will be probed or alerted.
strings.audit_monitors_no_targets: Service monitoring is on but has no push target (no service rule in the notification center and the default target list is empty). Monitors will not probe or record events (the dashboard and reports will show no data). Set a group number under Alerts & daily card → default push target.
strings.audit_notify_center_active: The notification center is active ({count} rule(s)): covered kinds use their rule target, the rest use the default push target. This is normal and needs no action; review the coverage only if a kind receives nothing.
strings.audit_notify_rule_invalid: {count} notification-center rule(s) are inactive: they have no target or no notification kind selected.
strings.audit_notify_rule_unknown_kind: Unknown notification kind(s) in the rules: {kinds} (allowed: resource / service / offline / provider / daily / weekly / daily_image); they will not take effect.
strings.audit_offline_broadcast_requires_alerts: "Broadcast disconnects to all groups" is on but "resource and offline alerts" is off: disconnects are never detected, so the broadcast never fires. Turn the alert master switch on first.
strings.audit_provider_watch_no_targets: LLM service alerts are on but have no usable push target (no provider rule and no default target); repeated failures will not be delivered.
strings.audit_silence_enabled_without_time: Maintenance silence is on but no end time is set, so it has no effect (leave it empty for no silence).
strings.audit_silence_time_invalid: The maintenance silence end time "{value}" is malformed; use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, otherwise it will not apply.
strings.audit_target_format_suspect: Target "{target}" looks malformed: use a group number for groups, or default:FriendMessage:QQ for a private chat.
strings.audit_unknown_redact_rule: Unknown redaction value(s): {unknown}. Allowed: {allowed}. Unknown values are ignored.
strings.audit_webhook_no_token: The Komari webhook is on with "require token" enabled but no token is set, so it will refuse to start. Set a token or turn that switch off.
strings.audit_webhook_open_no_token: The Komari webhook listens on all interfaces ({host}) without token authentication ("require token" is off); it will refuse to start for safety. Enable it and set a token, or bind 127.0.0.1.
strings.audit_weekly_report_no_targets: The weekly report is on but has no usable push target (no weekly rule and no default target); it will not be sent.
strings.chart_aria_label: Resource trend chart (use the arrow keys to inspect values)
strings.db_unavailable: The database is temporarily unavailable and is recovering automatically; what you see may be stale
strings.db_unavailable_panel: The database is temporarily unavailable and is recovering automatically. Switch tabs or refresh the page in a moment.
strings.db_unavailable_retry: The database is temporarily unavailable and is recovering automatically; please retry the export later
strings.empty_events: No anomaly events in this range
strings.error_bridge: Plugin page bridge is unavailable. Open this page from AstrBot.
strings.error_hidden: Hidden (the error contains a host or address)
strings.export_empty: No data to export in the selected range
strings.export_truncated: Volume exceeded the cap; only the most recent records were exported
strings.history_gaps: {count} downtime gap(s) (gray bands): the plugin or AstrBot was down and nothing was sampled.
strings.history_range_short: Only {days} days of data; less than {range}
strings.history_range_truncated: Range exceeded the cap; only the most recent {days} days are shown
strings.history_truncated: Range data exceeded the cap; only the most recent records are shown
strings.monitor_config_error_invalid_port: port {port} is not a valid 1–65535 port
strings.monitor_disabled_hint: Enable Service Monitoring in the plugin settings to see probe results here.
strings.monitor_summary: OK {ok} · Degraded {degraded} · Failed {fail} · Unknown {unknown} · Config issues {config_error}
strings.monitor_verify_timeout: {count} more monitor item(s) did not finish within 80 seconds and were cancelled.
strings.network_note_db: Network rates come from report samples (about one every {minutes} minutes), same window as the resource chart.
strings.network_note_redacted: Network data is hidden by the dashboard redaction setting.
strings.network_note_state: The network chart comes from the plugin's state.json (60 sample points by default, about 1 hour); enable "record daily history" to follow the selected range.
strings.network_redacted: Network data hidden by redaction settings
strings.quality_note: Success rate = completed / (completed + errors); interrupted calls (aborted) are listed separately and do not count as failures. An interruption means the call was cancelled - not necessarily by a person: same-session takeovers (new messages/commands), other plugins stopping the event, or upstream timeouts being cancelled. Latency and TTFT cover successful calls only; TTFT 0 means not recorded. Based on AstrBot provider_stats.
strings.quality_note_long: {n} interruption(s) in this window lasted ≥60 s - usually cancelled after upstream timeouts, worth checking.
strings.quality_note_truncated: More than 20,000 requests in the window; only the newest rows are counted, so totals may be lower.
strings.quality_truncated: More than 20,000 rows today; only the newest are counted, so totals may be lower
strings.reason_llm_data_broken: The LLM service quality data is malformed
strings.reason_no_llm_calls: No LLM call records in the selected range
strings.reason_no_provider_data: No provider requests in the selected range
strings.reason_no_qq_data: No QQ snapshots yet; data accumulates after the report history is enabled
strings.reason_process_since: Process sampling has been accumulating since {first_day}; no data for {day}
strings.reason_provider_query_failed: Failed to query the LLM call records
strings.reason_qq_redacted: QQ statistics are hidden by the redaction settings
strings.reason_resource_incomplete_day: Resource sampling has been accumulating since {first_day}; not enough data for {day}
strings.reason_resource_incomplete_span: Resource sampling has been accumulating since {first_day}; not enough data for the last {span} days
strings.reason_resource_since: Resource sampling has been accumulating since {first_day}; no data for {day}
strings.reason_website_since: Website latency has been accumulating since {first_day}; no data for {day}
strings.refresh_stale: A refresh is already running; showing the previous data
strings.report_anomaly_data_truncated: The event count for this day exceeded the row limit: some incidents may be missing and the durations may be inaccurate.
strings.report_build_failed: Failed to build the daily report; please retry later.
strings.report_build_timeout: The report build timed out; please retry later.
strings.report_day_out_of_range: Date is outside the supported range (last 30 years).
strings.report_gaps: {count} downtime gap(s): the plugin or AstrBot was down, so nothing was sampled.
strings.report_sections_empty: No report content selected: daily_report.sections is empty. Pick the sections in the config page.
strings.report_sections_invalid: No valid report sections configured; check the selections on the config page.
strings.verify_confirm_targets: A verification message will really be sent to every configured push target. Continue?
strings.verify_hint: "Push targets" really sends a verification message and reports per-target receipts; "Monitors" probes once without touching alerting state; "Webhook" posts a simulated event to this plugin's listener to exercise the receive → parse → push chain.
strings.verify_monitor_disabled: Service monitors are disabled: this was a manual probe only; nothing is checked or alerted in the background.
strings.verify_monitor_items_incomplete: {count} monitor item(s) have incomplete config (missing URL/port etc.); complete them and retry
strings.verify_monitor_no_targets: No push target for service monitors: nothing is checked or alerted in the background.
strings.verify_too_frequent: Too many attempts. Please try again in 30 seconds.
strings.verify_webhook_bad: HTTP {status}: check the token and target settings.
strings.verify_webhook_ok: Chain verified (HTTP 200): listen → parse → push all fine.
strings.verify_webhook_unreachable: Cannot reach the webhook listener: check host/port and that the plugin process is running.
strings.webhook_not_running: Webhook is not listening (it may have failed to start; see the log)
